notes: Text master for the shared robot lines. The voice script reads it. Voice: "flip robot character" (eLkzmL7sIxy7PLUgCfeT) on eleven_v4. [tags] are ElevenLabs audio tags. They describe sounds and delivery, never actions; actions live in pose (hand poses in order). Robot moments (v2, 2026-10-21, his tag style): about one robot sound per line, between phrases, never on a target word, a letter name or a Hebrew word. Pauses use [short pause] / [pause] / [long pause]. recipe = tone recipe 1-6 in the doc. status: approved = words seen and approved on 2026-10-19 (only tags changed in v2); draft = new, to review. From 2026-10-22 the review happens only on the Robot Line Review page (Robot lines tab); this file is synced from it. 2026-10-24: his first review on the page applied (kept lines approved; 9 rewritten from his notes; reveal-open-02 dropped and redrafted).
letters_note: z: Zee (American), decided 2026-10-21. a: spelled Eigh, because Ay was voiced wrong; chosen by ear on 2026-10-23.

lines.text: [startled, robotic beep] Oh! A visitor! [whispers] Quick, look busy… [loudly] Hello! Very busy inventor here!
[proudly] Sha-LOM! [short pause] Shalom? Sha-lom? [electronic glitches] [whispers] I practised all night.
[grandly] Welcome to my laboratory! [metal crash] [short pause] …Mind the mess.
Five words! [counting] One… two… [electronic glitches] [sighs] No fingers. Let's just start.
Yalla, yalla! [robot chuckles, high buzzing sounds] [whispers] I learned that word yesterday.
[metal knuckles cracking, clank clank] Ow. [short pause] Okay. Ready!
[gasps] I know you! [computer bleeps] …Do I know you? Yes! [short pause] Maybe.
[gasps] Ooh! [robot whispers] Act normal. [loudly, not normal at all] HELLO THERE!
[robot giggles, high buzzing sounds] Hee hee… I know this one… [short pause] [confused robotic beep] How do you spell it?
lines.old_text: [robot giggles, high buzzing sounds] Hee hee… I know this one. [short pause] I know it so much.

lines.text: [giggles] Oh, I like this one. [soft robotic beep] [whispers] Don't tell the others.
[screams] AAAH! [sparks crackling] [very calm] …Oh. It's just a picture.
[shocked] WHOA! [spring boing] My eyebrows jumped off! [short pause] …No, they're here.
[thoughtful] Hmm… yes… [robotic whirring] I see… [short pause] I see…
lines.old_text: [thoughtful] Hmm… yes… [robotic whirring] I see… [whispers] I see nothing.

lines.text: [hums] Mm-hm… mm-hm… [soft computer bleeps] [whispers] I'm not looking. I'm not looking.
[robotic malfunctioning sounds] It's on the tip of my… [electronic glitches] tongue. [short pause] I don't have a tongue.

idle.moment: Kid idle 10 s (he thinks, then sinks)

lines.text: I'll just close my eyes… for one second… [snores, robotic whirring down] [surprised, robotic beep] I'm awake! I'm awake!
[hums a little tune, robotic buzzing] [whistles] [short pause] I'm not waiting. I'm just… here.
[deep sigh, steam hissing] When I was a young robot… [long pause] …I forgot. Never mind.
[whispers] Psst… [tiny robotic beep] you there?
lines.old_text: [whispers] Psst… [tiny robotic beep] is it safe?

lines.text: [whispers] I am not here. [quiet electronic glitch] You can't see me.
[whispers] Peek-a-boo! [robot giggles, high buzzing sounds]

wake.moment: Wake (the kid's next input after the sink)

lines.text: [startled, robotic beep] Oh! You're back! [whispers] I missed you. A little.
[flustered] I'm awake! [gears grinding] Working, working! [short pause] …What are we doing?

press.moment: All slots filled, or the dome nudge after a correct answer

lines.text: The button… [whispers] it's looking at you. [soft robotic beep] [whispers] I think it likes you.
[whispers loudly] Press it! [short pause] Press it! [electronic glitches] [very calm] …No pressure.
[tapping on glass] Button. Hello. [computer bleeps] Somebody wants to press you.

mumble.moment: Wrong check, before any words (no words)

lines.text: [confused] Hmm-mm? [questioning robotic beep]
[confused] Ehh? [electronic glitch]
[long thinking noise] Uhhhh… [little beep] you missed a spot…
[thinking] Emmm… [robotic whirring] [curious] didn't you forget something?

wrong.moment: Wrong check, after the mumble (his memory, never the kid)

lines.text: [hollow metal knocking] Hello? Memory? [echo] …Nobody home.
Hmm… my memory says… [electronic glitches] spaghetti. [stomach rumbles] My memory is hungry.
Hmm. Let me shake my head… [loose parts rattling] [short pause] Nope. Not that one.
[proudly] Hmm… that would be correct… [electronic glitch] if it was a different word!
lines.old_text: [proudly] I remember! It's— [robotic malfunctioning sounds] [disappointed] …No. I remembered spaghetti again.

lines.text: [whispers] Let's try again. [soft robotic beep] [whispers] And pretend that this didn't happen.
lines.old_text: [whispers] Let's try again. [soft robotic beep] [whispers] But quietly, so my memory doesn't hear.

hint.moment: Second miss, as his letter lands

lines.text: [loose parts rattling] Wait… something is loose in my head… [metal clunk] A letter! Here, take it!
[sneezes] ATCHOO! [sparks crackling] Oh! A letter came out! [proudly] I'll put it there.
[gasps] Wait wait wait! [happy robotic beeping] [whispers] I remember ONE. [short pause] Just one. Don't get excited.

reveal-open.moment: Third miss, before the word and its letters

lines.text: [groans] Ohhhh… [loud metal clang] Ow. [short pause] I remember now!
Okay! Let me show you. [slow computer bleeps] Loading… loading… [ding] Here it is!
lines.dropped_text: [very dramatic] Wait! It's coming… [gears grinding] it's coming… IT CAME!
lines.by: Claude 2026-10-24, old line dropped in review

lines.text: [laughs, high buzzing sounds] Silly me! It was in my pocket all along!
[whispers] Next time, we get it together. [soft robotic beep] Deal?
[surprised] Ooooh! [robotic whirring] Now I see!
lines.old_text: [cheerful] I'll write it on my hand! [short pause] [robotic whirring down] …I have mittens.

correct.moment: Correct, after the word (when no gag line plays)

lines.text: YES! [happy robotic beeping] [out of breath] …Okay. I need to sit down.
Correct! [sniffs, electronic glitch] I'm not crying. [loud nose blowing] HONK.
[gasps] It's back! It's back in my head! [happy robotic beeping] [whispers] Hello, word. Stay.
You did it! [proudly] I helped. [short pause] A little. [electronic glitch] …Not really.
[cheers] Yes! [robot chuckles, high buzzing sounds] Now I do the win dance… [clanking, happy robotic whirring] [short pause] [proudly] Done!
lines.old_text: [cheers] Yes! [robot chuckles, high buzzing sounds] Eyebrows, dance!

streak.moment: 3 in a row, after the word

lines.text: Three! Call the king! [short pause] We have no king… [computer bleeps] Call the toaster!
[amazed] Three in a row?! [whispers] My gears are spinning… [gears whirring fast] [dizzy] whooa…
[shouts] FIRE! You're on fire! [short pause] Not real fire. [sparks crackling] [whispers] Don't call anyone.
Good practice! [whispers] The stars are shy today. [robotic beep] [shouts] COME OUT, STARS!
[warmly] Again? Again! [whispers] This time I'll remember harder. [strains, motor revving] Nnnngh!
[proudly] Practice! Every great inventor starts with practice. [coughs, steam hissing] And a lot of smoke.
[pleased] Very good! [happy robotic beeping] [whispers] My memory feels… shinier.
[happy] Two stars! [counting] One… two… [computer bleeps] [proudly] I counted that myself!
[happy] Good job! [short pause] [robot chuckles] I'm going to tell the toaster about you.
[over the top] WOW! THREE STARS! [happy robotic beeping] I need sunglasses!
[overjoyed] Sa-BA-ba! [short pause] Did I say it right? [electronic glitches] [whispers] Sababa!
[grandly] Ladies and gentlemen… a SUPERSTAR! [applause noises with his mouth, happy beeping]
[excited] Ooh, a new one! [robotic beep] [whispers] Don't lick it.
For the album! For the album! [short pause] What album? [electronic glitch] Oh, THAT album!
[admiring, soft robotic whirring] Shiny… [whispers] Can robots have stickers too?
[amazed] New level! [metal click, gears whirring up] Something just clicked in my head!
Level up! [happy robotic beeping] [proudly] I remember more words now! [short pause] …Not the spelling.
[whispers] Bigger words are coming. [robotic whirring] Hold my mitten.
[gasps] A gear! [sniffing, little electronic buzz] Mmm, fresh. [whispers] Don't spend it all at once.
[proudly] Gears! [metal jingling] We're rich! [short pause] Rich robots!
[straining, motor revving] Nnnnngh… [pop] There! I remembered one!
[thinking hard, computer bleeps] It starts with… [drumroll with his mouth]
[shooing] Go home, extra letters! [electric buzz] [whispers] Nobody invited you.

lines.text: [very slowly, like a sleepy robot, robotic whirring down] Oooookay… very… slowly… now…
[empty pockets rattling] Empty! [short pause] Let's play and earn some!
[sighs, steam hissing] No gears… [whispers] I'd give you mine, but I need them to think.

clean_format: Clean target words and letter names are voiced on their own with an exclamation mark ('Cat!', 'Zee!'), chosen by ear on 2026-10-22 over a full stop.
